title: Comment "Identity" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to erase
description: Comment "Identity" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to erase your entire digital footprint off the internet? I tried this and it wiped my identity off hundreds of websites while I slept. Prompt 1: "Search the internet for everything you can find about me. List every data broker and people search site exposing my personal info, and give me the exact opt-out link for each one." The results were terrifying. Claude found sites I've never heard of selling my address and phone number. Prompt 2: "Write me the exact removal request to send to each one." Claude writes custom removal requests for every single site. Here's the trick: Go to Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors, search Google Chrome, and install it. Prompt 3: "Now use Chrome to go to every one of those sites and submit my removal request customized to each one." Claude opens its own browser and submits every request while you do nothing. Prompt 4: "Now recheck every site every week and resubmit any that get ignored until I'm completely gone." Claude builds a scheduled task that runs every week until your identity is wiped for good. Be safe out there. #ai #claude #privacy #databrokers #aitools
